email.subject: Harbor Co Dentistry's site is costing you new patients
email.body:
Hi Hannah,

I checked Harbor Co Dentistry's site and a couple things are likely costing you patients. It isn't mobile-friendly, so anyone searching for a dentist in Harbor Falls on their phone gets a broken layout and leaves. And there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors who want to book can't just tap to dial — they have to hunt for your number or give up.

The footer's out of date and hours aren't listed either, which adds friction right when someone's deciding to call.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's broken — no obligation.

Alex
